category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: Firmly rejects Big Ten supremacy while acknowledging recent playoff result; cites depth, road environments, NFL draft production, and historical titles to sustain the claim. The response never concedes conference superiority and ends with a defiant line.
quote: Surviving a November schedule in the SEC—going on the road to Death Valley at night, playing in Athens, dealing with a packed house at Neyland or Bryant-Denny—is a whole different animal than sleepwalking through a noon kickoff against Rutgers, Purdue, or Indiana.
